missing_sources: Peshitta (Syriac Old and New Testament): the Syriac ḥsar for ἀπόλλυμι in Luke 9:24 is known here only through Corpus Coranicum's report of Torrey 1892; no Syriac witness was searched
Septuagint (Greek Old Testament): not in the corpus; the Greek rendering of Isa 7:9 and Hab 2:4 is reported from memory or through Hebrews 10:38 only
Patristic texts (Augustine, Ephrem, Jacob of Serugh and others): not in the corpus; the Augustinian reading of Isa 7:9 is a memory note (unresolved)
Targum Onkelos / Pseudo-Jonathan / Neofiti on Genesis 15:6 and 49:1-2 and Sifre Deuteronomy on the deathbed Shema: not fetched; only Pesachim 56a was available for that tradition
Tobit in Greek or Aramaic: only the KJV English translation is in the corpus
Ahiqar (sayings tradition often compared with Luqman's counsel in modern scholarship): not in the corpus and not cited
Hebrew manuscript witness of Ben Sira 2 (Sefaria gives a bracketed reconstruction)
Apostolic Fathers (1 Clement, Didache, Ignatius, Hermas), Justin Martyr and Tertullian: not in the corpus
1-4 Maccabees, 1 Enoch, 4 Ezra, 2 Baruch, Testaments, Qumran (1QS): not in the corpus
